referenceVehicle: 1986 Ford RS200 stock 1.8 road homologation coupe, LHD five-speed manual; factory-delivered AWD, not S/Evolution/race car

sources.access: Ford owner manual Issue 1 archived by owners club. Visually read PDF pages 16-19, printed 01-3 to 01-6. Road specification, not subsequent competition-change chapters.
FIA road-car narrative confirms 250 hp at 6500 rpm, 215 lb-ft at 4500 rpm; distinguishes later Evolution and competition cars.
Original Ford FIA B-280 base form pages 2,6,7,8 visually read. Gearbox/transfer/axle corroboration only. Do not substitute competition dimensions/variants for road manual.

verifiedFacts.massCondition: Kerb with full fuel, liquids, tools and spare

estimates: Engine maximum 7400 rpm is sourced; visual redline 7000 and idle 1000 are estimates. Owner manual power row has unclear DIN/PS label 187(250); use FIA explicit 250 hp corroboration, not 187 PS. Torque/power plateaus modeled from manual 4000-5000/6500-7000 ranges, other curve points are estimates.

Game has one final-drive scalar: axle 4.375 multiplied once by primary transfer 1.043 = 4.563125. Published overall gear reductions agree within source rounding. Raw gear ratios retained. No competition close-ratio or later Evolution parts.
Auto Assist automates the stock 5MT for gameplay; not a factory automatic. Shift/clutch/launch timing and 84% driveline efficiency are estimates.

Road manual width 1764mm takes precedence over homologation 1785mm. Manual front overhang 788mm plus rear692+wheelbase2530 totals4010 rather than stated4000; rig uses FIA base778mm front to close envelope, explicitly cross-source reconciliation.
Factory 37/63 torque split retained, Ferguson viscous limited-slip simplified to estimated game locking values. No RWD selector, center lock or exact thermal-viscous behavior simulated.

.38drag,.46mCG,13:1 steering ratio (manual only gives2.6turns), collider sections, tire grip, springs/damping/brake balance/aero are gameplay estimates.140mph and6.1sec display targets unvalidated; no performance calibration claim.

Owner manual nominal rolling radius .3088m used rather than unloaded geometric .3157m. Alignment source retained; rear toe .25 degrees interpreted as axle setting in game. Original teal/ivory 2994 art deliberately differs from original white road-car paint. Shared tires, wheel and surface smoke assets retained.
